x: Dave King and Bernard Eglinton both fresh from the Mercury walked magnificently to bring the team in 2nd equal. 1st Handicap P.L.
The hot sun took its toll leading to Tom Cook's retirement at 19 miles. 1st Sussex Man - P.L.

A welcome return was made by that stalwart of long distance racing, P.L. Duncan, who fresh from his high altitude training camp in the South of France powered home in 48:30, although it was rumoured, by a certain gentleman of leisure who was taking stock of the situation, that "he didn't half die on the hill".
